versification: R. H. Charles source numbering normalized to logical chapters 1-108 and contiguous integer verses; lettered subverses and parallel E/G^g readings are preserved in merged text/source_parts

verses.text_en: Then said I: ‘For what object is this blessed land, which is entirely filled with trees, and this accursed valley 〚between?〛’
verses.text_hr: Tada rekoh: ‘Čemu služi ova blagoslovljena zemlja, posve ispunjena drvećem, i ova prokleta dolina 〚između njih?〛’

verses.text_en:
[common reading] 〚Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said: ‘This〛 valley is for those who are accursed for ever: here shall all ⌜the accursed⌝ be gathered together who utter with their lips against the Lord unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things.

[variant E · continuation] Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.

[variant G^g · continuation] Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be the place of their habitation.
verses.text_hr:
[zajedničko čitanje] 〚Tada Uriel, jedan od svetih anđela koji bijaše sa mnom, odgovori: ‘Ova〛 je dolina za one koji su zauvijek prokleti. Ovdje će se okupiti svi ⌜prokleti⌝ koji svojim usnama protiv Gospodina izgovaraju nedolične riječi i grubo govore o Njegovoj slavi.

[varijanta E · nastavak] Ovdje će biti okupljeni i ovdje će biti mjesto njihova suda.

[varijanta G^g · nastavak] Ovdje će biti okupljeni i ovdje će biti mjesto njihova prebivališta.

verses.text_en:
[variant E] In the last days there shall be upon them the spectacle of righteous judgement in the presence of the righteous for ever: here shall the merciful bless the Lord of Glory, the Eternal King.

[variant G^g] In the last times, in the days of the true judgement in the presence of the righteous for ever: here shall the =godly= bless the Lord of Glory, the Eternal King.
verses.text_hr:
[varijanta E] U posljednje će dane pred pravednicima dovijeka biti izloženi prizoru pravednoga suda; ovdje će milosrdni blagoslivljati Gospodina Slave, Vječnoga Kralja.

[varijanta G^g] U posljednja vremena, u dane istinskoga suda pred pravednicima dovijeka, ovdje će =pobožni= blagoslivljati Gospodina Slave, Vječnoga Kralja.

verses.text_en: In the days of judgement over the former, they shall bless Him for the mercy in accordance with which He has assigned them (their lot).’
verses.text_hr: U dane suda nad onima prije spomenutima blagoslivljat će Ga zbog milosrđa po kojemu im je dodijelio (njihov dio).’

verses.text_en: Then I blessed the Lord of Glory and set forth His ⌜glory⌝ and lauded Him gloriously.
verses.text_hr: Tada blagoslovih Gospodina Slave, objavih Njegovu ⌜slavu⌝ i slavno Ga hvalih.
